description: Alerts surface a short, contextual message (info, success, error, warning). This theme drops a soft box-shadow on every alert and colorizes variants via an exos `alert-builder` @each loop over the $theme-color-with-lighter-background map — each variant pairs a tinted 'lighter' background with the matching text color. A 24px leading icon (alert-icon) and a trailing dismiss button (btn-dismiss) compose the row. Use alert-wrapper to pin a stack of alerts beneath the top nav.

always: Apply the base class `alert` plus exactly one `alert-{color}` variant.
Set role="alert" on the root so assistive tech announces the message.
Pair the variant with a meaningful icon and message text, not color alone.
never: Do not use `alert-dark`, `alert-info`, or `alert-light` — the exos alert-builder only generates primary, success, danger, warning and secondary.
Do not rely on color alone to convey meaning; include an icon and/or text.
Do not stack two alert-{color} modifiers on one alert.

a11y: Add role="alert" (or aria-live="assertive" for transient toasts) so screen readers announce the message.
Mark the decorative leading glyph inside .alert-icon with aria-hidden="true".
The dismiss control (.btn-dismiss) is icon-only, so give it an aria-label such as "Dismiss".

color.description: Contextual color variant. Generated by the exos alert-builder @each loop over $theme-color-with-lighter-background (tinted 'lighter' background + matching text color).

root.note: Add role="alert". The flex row holds icon + message + optional dismiss.

children.note: 24px leading status icon; mark the inner glyph aria-hidden.
Trailing close button, auto-pushed to the right (margin-left:auto). Requires aria-label.
